title: My hobby: photography
instructions: Yuki fotoğrafçılık hobisini anlatıyor. Ne zaman başladığına ve neyin fotoğrafını çektiğine dikkat et.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: I started taking photos two years ago, when my grandfather gave me his old camera.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: At first, I only took photos with my phone. Now I always use the camera.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: I like taking photos of birds and trees. I don't like taking photos of people.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: Every Saturday morning, I go to the forest near my town.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: Last month, one of my photos won a prize in a local competition.

script.speaker: yuki
script.text: Now I want to buy a better lens, but it is very expensive.

questions.evidence: when my grandfather gave me his old camera.

questions.prompt: What does Yuki like taking photos of?
questions.feedback: Kuşların ve ağaçların fotoğrafını çekmeyi seviyor; insanları sevmiyor.
questions.evidence: I like taking photos of birds and trees.

options: One of her photos won a prize.
questions.feedback: Fotoğraflarından biri yerel bir yarışmada ödül kazandı.
questions.evidence: Last month, one of my photos won a prize
